verdict.rationale: Mastra provides a CLI (`npx mastra api workflow run ...`) and Studio for running agents/workflows locally, and headless Node.js execution is supported, which lets a script or agent invoke and verify workflow/agent output from a terminal. However, there's no dedicated 'example agents' repo or documented headless verification flow specifically for an agent to check its own build output. Missing for 10: documented example-agent templates runnable headlessly out of the box, explicit guidance/tooling for an agent to programmatically verify its own generated code via CLI, and independent hands-on confirmation of this specific workflow.
